text:
jess_sales: Heads-up: Evergreen Insurance wants a proof-of-concept next week. Requirements: on-prem entitlement proxy that terminates SAML, supports SCIM delta webhooks, enforces RBAC via local OPA, and keeps all logs inside their air-gapped environment. They also want a pricing estimate for a 6-month POC + enterprise contract.

toni_se: Ok. Questions: 1) Do they expect mutual TLS for SCIM callbacks? 2) Do they need assertion export to our cloud for audit, or must it stay local?

jess_sales: They want everything local by default. Export only if we have signed agreement. mTLS preferred.

nate_infra: Tech notes: Private deployment can run as a single-VM connector in customer network. We support mTLS for SCIM and SAML SP endpoints. For air-gapped, updates are via a signed bundle they pull. HSM support is optional + additional cost.

rebecca_pse: For OPA: recommended pattern is an OPA sidecar on the connector host. Policy decisions returned synchronously. We log evaluation decisions to local file and optionally forward an aggregated metric to Redwood when allowed.

jess_sales: They asked about user provisioning speed: ~15k users, delta only, expected churn 200/day. Any concerns?

nate_infra: 200/day is fine. We need durable message queue on the connector to handle transient network to our ingest endpoint. For air-gapped mode, queue depth must be configured; recommend 48h retention.

toni_se: Config snippet for SCIM delta registration (example):
```
POST /scim/v2/Subscriptions
{
  "callbackUrl": "https://connector.local/scim/callback",
  "auth": "mutual_tls",
  "filters": "Resources eq \"User\""
}
```

rebecca_pse: Edge cases: Some IdPs send group-membership changes separately. Ensure OPA policies can reference both user and group change events before enforcement.

jess_sales: They want RBAC mapping to Redwood roles + local admin overrides. Is role sync supported?

nate_infra: Yes — we support mapping rules: SCIM group -> Redwood role. Local overrides can be stored in connector DB (encrypted). We need to document conflict resolution rules.

legal_qa: Compliance flags: If assertions are stored, they may be considered personal data. We need to mark retention policy in SQA and get customer sign-off. Also, forwarding any PII upstream requires DPA amendment.

jess_sales: Noted — customer prefers no assertion storage unless requested. We should surface that in the SQA.

rebecca_pse: Canary plan suggestion: 50 users, single team, run for 72 hours. Verify SAML assertion audience + ACs, SCIM diffs, OPA deny/allow patterns. If green, scale to 5k.

toni_se: Samples to give them: SAML SP metadata url, sample SCIM patch, OPA policy stub.

rebecca_pse: OPA stub:
```rego
package authz

default allow = false
allow {
  input.user.active
  input.user.groups[_] == "engineers"
}
```

toni_se: SCIM patch sample: 
```json
{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [{ "op": "replace", "value": { "userName": "m.lee", "active": true }}] }
```

jess_sales: Pricing: can product ops send a POC quote template? We need: 6-week POC price, connector setup fee, optional HSM, PM support hours.

nate_infra: I'll draft a technical SOW: connector sizing, network ports (443 outbound optional, 8443 admin), cert rotation steps, bundle update procedure.

legal_qa: I'll prepare the SQA pack and a DPA addendum template. Also flag export controls if customer is in EMEA with data residency needs.

jess_sales: Action items: nate -> SOW + ports list; rebecca -> OPA example + conflict rules doc; toni -> SCIM retry semantics docs; legal_qa -> SQA + DPA. I'll book a presales call Tue 10:00 PT.

compliance_bot: POC workspace created: evergreen-poc-2026, docs folder: https://redwood.internal/pocs/evergreen (access via SSO).

jess_sales: Thanks. I'll attach the customer's network diagram and ask for their preferred cert rotation window. :white_check_mark:
